description: Compiles ONE block (not the whole PLC) and returns the same message tree, Gd8 verification summary (only ERROR blocks, warnings don't), located[] and nextHints as tia_compile. A clean block compile is NOT the Gd9 precondition for download/S7: run tia_compile for the whole PLC before that. 404 not_found when the block does not exist. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it resolves the block and returns the plan {block, blockType, isConsistent} WITHOUT compiling. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/blocks/{block}/compile. M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

name: tia_block_compile
title: TIA — compile one block
